Strategy sketch dictated on a call. XAUUSD, London hours, 15m chart.

First I want to see a large 15m rejection wick against the prior move.

Then the very next thing has to be a subsequent no-wick directional
confirmation in the opposite direction, on the same 15m timeframe.

After that there is an optional lower-timeframe 5m trigger, but I will take
the setup without it.
